user_query: trass stories and gmail with terms international launch uk au ca tax registration

intent.goal: Find content about international tax/business registration in UK, Australia, and Canada

generated_query:
SELECT DISTINCT
u.page_id,
u.workspace,
u.database_name,
u.title,
u.created_time,
COALESCE(g.subject, '') as subject,
COALESCE(g.sender_name, '') as sender,
COALESCE(g.body_snippet, '') as snippet,
COALESCE(g.message_content, '') as content
FROM unified_content u
LEFT JOIN gmail_content g ON u.page_id = g.page_id
WHERE u.database_name IN ('stories', 'gmail')
AND (
    LOWER(u.title) LIKE '%international%' OR
    LOWER(u.title) LIKE '%launch%' OR 
    LOWER(u.title) LIKE '%uk%' OR
    LOWER(u.title) LIKE '%au%' OR
    LOWER(u.title) LIKE '%ca%' OR
    LOWER(u.title) LIKE '%tax%' OR
    LOWER(u.title) LIKE '%registration%' OR
    LOWER(g.subject) LIKE '%international%' OR
    LOWER(g.subject) LIKE '%launch%' OR
    LOWER(g.subject) LIKE '%uk%' OR
    LOWER(g.subject) LIKE '%au%' OR
    LOWER(g.subject) LIKE '%ca%' OR
    LOWER(g.subject) LIKE '%tax%' OR
    LOWER(g.subject) LIKE '%registration%' OR
    LOWER(g.body_snippet) LIKE '%international%' OR
    LOWER(g.body_snippet) LIKE '%launch%' OR
    LOWER(g.body_snippet) LIKE '%uk%' OR
    LOWER(g.body_snippet) LIKE '%au%' OR
    LOWER(g.body_snippet) LIKE '%ca%' OR
    LOWER(g.body_snippet) LIKE '%tax%' OR
    LOWER(g.body_snippet) LIKE '%registration%' OR
    LOWER(g.message_content) LIKE '%international%' OR
    LOWER(g.message_content) LIKE '%launch%' OR
    LOWER(g.message_content) LIKE '%uk%' OR
    LOWER(g.message_content) LIKE '%au%' OR
    LOWER(g.message_content) LIKE '%ca%' OR
    LOWER(g.message_content) LIKE '%tax%' OR
    LOWER(g.message_content) LIKE '%registration%'
)
ORDER BY u.created_time DESC
LIMIT 5000;
